theorems.name: Submission.variationMeasure_le_liminf_of_radonConverges
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → (∀ i, (Vi i).HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation) → (∀ W, IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → liminf (fun i ↦ variationMeasure (Vi i) W) atTop ≠ ∞) → V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation ∧ ∀ W, IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → variationMeasure V W ≤ liminf (fun i ↦ variationMeasure (Vi i) W) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
